title: 11 BUMN and Danantara Indonesia Join Forces to Begin Renovating SDN 1 Panggalih in Garut
excerpt: Danantara Indonesia, the Ministry of BUMN (state-owned enterprises), 11 BUMN, and Relawan Nusantara have begun renovating SDN 1 Panggalih in Cisewu, Garut, to support more adequate educational facilities.
seoTitle: Renovation of SDN 1 Panggalih, Garut, Begins - Relawan Nusantara
seoDescription: Danantara Indonesia, the Ministry of BUMN, 11 state-owned enterprises, and Relawan Nusantara begin renovating SDN 1 Panggalih in Cisewu, Garut.
html:
Creating a safe and comfortable learning environment for children takes care and cooperation from many parties. This spirit is being realized through a joint Social and Environmental Responsibility (Tanggung Jawab Sosial dan Lingkungan, TJSL) program initiated by Danantara Indonesia and the Ministry of BUMN (state-owned enterprises) together with 11 BUMN, in collaboration with Relawan Nusantara, to renovate SDN 1 Panggalih, a public elementary school in Cisewu District, Garut Regency, West Java.

The program officially began with the laying of the first stone, or groundbreaking, on Monday, 12 October 2026. The event marked the first step in the effort to provide more adequate educational facilities for the students of SDN 1 Panggalih.

The event was attended by the District Regional Coordinator of the Garut Regency Education Office, the school principal, the teachers' council, the school committee, and members of the local community. The presence and enthusiasm of the students also enlivened the start of their school's renovation.

Providing Safer Learning Spaces

Before the renovation program began, the SDN 1 Panggalih building had suffered fairly significant damage due to its age and the weather. This condition raised concerns about the safety and comfort of students and teaching staff during teaching and learning activities.

A school is not merely a place where children gain knowledge, but also a space to grow, build their aspirations, and develop their potential. For that reason, adequate educational facilities are an important part of supporting their learning.

Through this renovation, it is hoped that SDN 1 Panggalih will have a safer and more comfortable learning environment, so that students and teachers can carry out educational activities better.

Cross-Sector Cooperation for Education

The renovation of SDN 1 Panggalih is the result of a collaboration between Danantara Indonesia, the Ministry of BUMN, and 11 BUMN, namely PT Wijaya Karya (WIKA), Indonesia Financial Group (IFG), PT PLN (Persero), PT Waskita Karya, Peruri, PT Hutama Karya, PT Nindya Karya, PT Adhi Karya, PT Brantas Abipraya, PT Pembangunan Perumahan (PP), and Perum Perumnas.

Together with Relawan Nusantara, this collaboration is an expression of cross-sector care in supporting better educational facilities, particularly in areas where school infrastructure needs attention.

This synergy also shows that the effort to provide better education requires the involvement of many parties. Through the support and role of each, the TJSL program is expected to deliver real benefits for the community.

Nurturing Hope for the Next Generation

This groundbreaking is the beginning of a long process to provide more adequate learning spaces for the children of SDN 1 Panggalih. More than physical construction, the renovation carries the hope that students can learn with greater calm, comfort, and enthusiasm.

Through the collaboration that has been built, Danantara Indonesia, the Ministry of BUMN, the 11 BUMN, and Relawan Nusantara are striving to play a part in supporting the continuity of education in the regions.

After all, every child has the right to the opportunity to learn and achieve their dreams. And an adequate learning environment is one of the important steps toward opening up that opportunity. Let us work together to support equal access to educational facilities in every corner of Indonesia!

Luaskan Manfaat
